concerns.text: SC-002 ‘reduction in dynamic execution cycles (percentage of tasks skipped)’ is specified in the spec but no task implements the calculation or reporting of this metric. Add a task (e.g., T022) that computes the proportion of tasks omitted from dynamic execution after applying the model threshold and records it (e.g., in a JSON summary).

SC-004 ‘computational feasibility (runtime and memory usage) ≤6h, ~7 GB RAM’ is required by the spec but there is no task that measures, logs, and validates pipeline runtime or memory consumption against these GitHub Actions constraints. Add a monitoring task (e.g., T023) that records total execution time and peak memory usage and fails if limits are exceeded.
